verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail offers AI summaries, automatic labels and categorization, plus junk filtering so users can 'focus on the mail that matters.' That could help surface important items, but nothing shows government or legal mail being specifically identified, flagged or prioritized. Missing for 10: explicit detection of IRS/state/service-of-process mail, priority flagging or urgent alerts for compliance-critical mail, deadline tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
